alina-support: Hey team, escalating an enterprise customer bug. When they run CSV export from Console -> Analytics -> Sessions with a 30d custom range, the download is an empty file (0 bytes) for exports that include non-ASCII user metadata. Happening for 2 customers now. job id: export_20260316_431

maria-support: Thanks. Any repro steps or job id logs? Is this only for large ranges?

alina-support: Repro steps I ran: 1) login as customer org 4321 2) Console -> Analytics -> Sessions 3) set range 2026-02-10 to 2026-03-11 4) export CSV (include user_properties) -> download link returns 200 but file size 0. Small ranges (1-2 days) succeed.

samir-engineer: Can you paste the presigned URL headers from the link click? Also need the export service trace id.

alina-support: From browser network: GET /download/export_20260316_431?sig=... -> 200 OK, Content-Length: 0, Content-Type: text/csv; charset=utf-8, x-amz-request-id: 7A2C9..., x-amz-id-2: AbCdEf... Trace: trc-5f8a2c

jordan-storage: On the backend we log upload completion with bytes_written. Do you have the export-service logs for that job id?

alina-support: Pasted logs from export-bot: 
```
[export-service] 2026-03-16T18:02:13Z INFO start export export_20260316_431 org=4321 user=ops@cust.com
[export-service] 2026-03-16T18:02:14Z INFO batching 34k rows estimated 6.2MB
[export-service] 2026-03-16T18:02:25Z INFO s3_presigned_upload upload_key=exports/4321/export_20260316_431.csv.gz status=200 bytes_written=0
[export-service] 2026-03-16T18:02:25Z ERROR upload_validation checksum_mismatch=true content_encoding=gzip content_type=text/csv; charset=utf-8
```

maria-support: bytes_written=0 is suspicious. Did gzip step fail? The content_encoding says gzip but bytes 0.

samir-engineer: That log implies the uploader attempted to stream compressed content but the compressor may have failed early and uploaded empty object. Check worker stderr; also check the temp gz file size before upload.

jordan-storage: I pulled worker logs: compressor threw an exception "UnicodeEncodeError: 'ascii' codec can't encode character '\u2019' in position 412" during CSV encode when user_properties had smart quotes. The compression pipeline was configured to encode with 'ascii' fallback, which returns empty buffer on error in our wrapper.

alina-support: So encoder error -> empty payload -> s3 object created 0 bytes and presigned link returns 200. Customer sees blank CSV. That matches.

maria-support: Is this limited to UTF-8 vs ASCII encoding? Customer opened CSV in Excel and saw garbled characters for smaller exports; here it just dropped content. Which codepath triggers ascii fallback?

samir-engineer: We recently merged a change to streaming_csv_writer to set errors='replace' for py<3.9 but our wrapper used errors='strict' in the gzip stream when non-ASCII encountered. It should have bubbled up exception instead of writing 0 bytes; our upload wrapper swallows exception and completes multipart upload with zero-length part. That's the bug.

alina-support: Patch/rollback? Customer is blocked and has an active renewal. Can we hotfix? cc @eng-oncall

eng-oncall: I'm on it. Priorities: 1) Disable swallow-and-complete in upload wrapper so failed upload returns 500 to Console and shows exported failed in UI. 2) Change csv encoder to use UTF-8 and errors='replace'. 3) Add unit test with non-ASCII properties and a staging export. Plan ETA 2 hours for deploy to staging, 6 hours to prod after QA.

jordan-storage: Also recommend adding a pre-upload size check: if compressed temp file size=0, abort before completing multipart. That avoids zero-byte objects.

samir-engineer: I'll push a small PR to set gzip stream to use 'utf-8' and errors='replace' plus adjust uploader to abort on zero-length part. Running CI now.

export-bot: CI build passed for branch fix/export-utf8-enc-2026-03-16 (build #4890).

alina-support: Rolling this with the customer on standby. Any impact to billing? They reported a token-based billing spike during export attempts.

samir-engineer: The spike was due to repeated export retries - each attempt computed CSV and streamed before failing. Fix will stop retries and surface error earlier. We should credit retries manually for the customer.

maria-support: I've flagged billing and will open a refund ticket referencing export_20260316_431 and session traces.

eng-oncall: Hotfix deployed to prod at 2026-03-16T22:10:04Z. Verified a repro export after fix: compressed temp file size=1.2MB, s3 bytes_written=1243210, Content-Encoding=gzip, download returns proper CSV. Customer confirmed file contains non-ASCII characters correctly.

alina-support: Customer confirmed fix works, thanks all. Closing ticket after billing follow-up. :tada:

maria-support: Filed billing adjustment ticket BIL-78123 and notified account manager.

samir-engineer: Follow-ups: add unit test, monitor exports for 48h for any further zero-length uploads, and audit recent releases for similar wrapper patterns.

alina-support: tagging this thread to #postmortems if we produce one and leaving notes for KB article on "CSV export empty file with non-ASCII characters" for Support playbook.

jordan-storage: created a bug in JIRA: INF-3129 with links to logs and PR.

alina-support: Thanks everyone, closing now.
